name: Feature Request
about: Suggest an idea or enhancement for Nebulae
title: '[ENHANCEMENT] '
labels: ['enhancement']
assignees: ''
---

## Feature Proposal
A clear and concise description of the suggested feature or improvement.

## Problem or User Scenario
What problem does this feature solve? Describe the scenario (e.g., managing 10,000+ seeding torrents, cross-platform interface binding, scheduling).

## Proposed Solution / Technical Design
Describe how this feature should work conceptually or technically. Mention relevant BitTorrent specifications (BEPs), OS network integration, or adapter designs if applicable.

## Alternatives Considered
Describe any alternative solutions or features you have considered.

## Additional Context
Add any relevant references, wireframes, or documentation links.
